question: Which of the following Indian state is biggest in terms of area?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• With a land **area of 342,239 square kilometers** and a population ranked eighth, **Rajasthan **is the** largest state in India.**
 
• Characterized by a primarily arid climate, the region includes the vast **Thar Desert**, which is the largest dry area in the nation.
 
• The **capital **of Rajasthan, **Jaipur **(also known as the** “Pink City”**), is a well-liked travel destination.
